aboutMore: real quick. moose is slower now. so we walk at 6 every morning, 4 blocks, and it takes 40 minutes. it used to be 15. i don't mind. i bought a ramp for the truck with lawn money. he gets a pizza crust on fridays. if you see a guy on a bench in the park at 6:15 AM with a dog and not saying anything, that's me. say hi. don't say anything about the dog. just say hi. he knows.

bulletins.subject: HOW TO WATCH A LAX GAME (bro, it's easy)
bulletins.body: 1) it's like hockey but outside. 2) the goalie wears the most pads and gets the least credit. say something nice to sven. 3) when somebody shoots, yell. it doesn't matter what. 4) when somebody scores, yell louder. 5) when somebody gets hit, say 'ohhh.' 6) don't stay for the post game handshake line, it's a long one. wait. no. stay. it's the best part. 7) if there's a dog in a truck at the edge of the lot, wave. 8) say 'bro' to a stranger. they'll say it back. that's lax. see u saturday.

bulletins.subject: THE TWO COLLAR GUIDE (a public service)
bulletins.body: one collar: casual. two collars: this is the one. three collars: a mistake (i've been there, don't ask). pop from the back, not the front. iron first (my mom does mine) (i'm learning). if someone asks why, say 'bro.' it's the only answer. if tony asks about the summit, say 'saturday.' if coach asks, say 'what collar.' that's the whole system. it's never failed.

blog.title: 6:14 AM (a post about moose)
blog.body: moose is 15. golden lab mix. mostly golden, a little lab, 100% moose. my dad brought him home from a farm in a box when i was 2 and my mom says i tried to feed him a crayon. he used to run the whole field behind the house. now we walk 4 blocks and it takes 40 minutes. i don't mind. i got a ramp for the truck last month with lawn money. he gets a pizza crust on fridays (the vet said ok). the thing about moose is he doesn't know i play lacrosse. he thinks i go to a field every day and come back. and he's always at the door when i get home. every day. 15 years. nobody else is that consistent. not even the sun. bro.

blog.title: sven's first lax practice (a story) (bro)
blog.body: so chad's family hosts sven, the exchange guy from sweden, and chad said 'bro come to lax, he's never seen it.' i handed him a stick. he looked at it for a while. he asked if the stick is for the ball or for the opponent. i said the ball. he said 'good, i was concerned.' we put him in goal bc nobody else wanted the pads. first shot hit him in the chest. he said 'sorry.' to the BALL. second shot, he said 'sorry' again and caught it. by the end of practice he'd saved 14 shots and apologized to all 14 of them. coach reilly pulled me aside and said 'where did you find him.' i said 'chad's spare room.' he said 'keep him.' he's our goalie now. he doesn't know what a ranch dressing is. i'm working on it. bro.

blog.title: how to pop a collar (and why two)
blog.body: step 1: iron it. step 2: flip it up from the back, not the front. step 3: do the other one. step 4: walk like it's all normal. why two? in 8th grade my older cousin gave me a polo that was too big and the tag was itchy so i popped the collar to hide it. then it looked weird with only one. so i did the other. and it became a thing. and then it became a lifestyle. and then my mom started ironing two. and now there's a whole team that does it and nobody remembers why. that's how a tradition starts, bro. somebody's neck itches. one collar is confidence. two is a lifestyle. three is a mistake. i've been there. it was picture day. nobody talks about it.
